summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FASE C — LOT KELAS SATU (Lot Management Phase C). Backend: 46/46 tests PASS. Frontend: 15/16 core features working. All critical lot management features operational including lot numbering (KSC/LOT-YYMM-####), enforcement modes, genealogy (split/merge/rework), recall tracing, and RBAC.
